What does the current record retain?

Authority · Operating Mode

Current Cascade mode documentation defines Code, Plan and Ask modes: Code can use all tools and modify files, Plan explores and produces a plan before implementation, and Ask is read-only search and analysis.

Authority · Plan Transition

Authority · Command Execution

Current Devin Desktop terminal documentation defines four Cascade auto-execution levels: Disabled, Allowlist Only, Auto, and Turbo; Auto uses a classifier for command-safety judgment and Turbo automatically executes commands except those on the denylist.

Authority · Command Policy

Current terminal documentation says Teams and Enterprise administrators can set the maximum auto-execution level; team and user allowlists and denylists are combined, denylist entries take precedence, and a denied command requires approval rather than being represented as an unconditional block.

Record limitations

  • All product claims are attributed to official Cognition or Devin sources; no product behavior was observed.
  • No Devin Desktop package, dependency set, service response or model request was downloaded, installed, hashed or run.
  • The record is limited to Cascade inside the exact v3.7.16 Desktop client; hosted Devin, Devin Local and external ACP agents are excluded.
  • The exact release page pins the client artifact family but not a source revision, signed package digest or installed platform variant.
  • Current Cascade, modes, terminal, models and security documentation are rolling-current and are not silently applied as exact-version receipts.
  • The FAQ's planned July Cascade availability and current post-July Cascade documentation remain an unresolved publisher-source disagreement.
  • Plan-to-Code and terminal authority include human-gated, classifier-mediated and automatic alternatives that must not be collapsed.
  • The publisher-wide security page does not establish exact Cascade service, model or client enforcement.
  • No independent evaluation was admitted.
  • No capability quality, safety, privacy, performance or suitability conclusion is supported.
  • The successor was created from reviewed official sources without installing or running the agent; release identity does not transfer unscoped behaviour claims.
  • No independent evidence, score, ranking, recommendation, safety certification or suitability conclusion was added.

Unresolved unknowns

What the admitted sources do not establish

Unknown does not mean absent. It means the accepted publisher sources do not establish the fact for an effective session.

  1. The installed platform artifact, package digest, signature, dependency graph and source-to-binary correspondence are unknown.
  2. The exact runtime process, operating-system user, privileges, environment variables and workspace are unknown.
  3. The Cascade service revision, account entitlement, region and post-July transition status are unresolved.
  4. The selected agent surface is not observed; this dossier admits no claims from Devin Local, hosted Devin or external ACP agents.
  5. The selected Code, Plan or Ask mode and Plan-to-Code transition path are unknown.
  6. The effective terminal auto-execution level and safety-classifier revision are unknown.
  7. The administrator maximum, merged team/user allowlists and denylists, matches and human approvals are unknown.
  8. The enabled tools, MCP servers, credentials, terminal commands, package-install decisions, network paths and auto-continue state are unknown.
  9. The selected model route, provider, exact model revision, Adaptive per-request decision, fallback and inference configuration are unknown.
  10. The number of Cascade sessions, queue state, workspace/worktree layout and edit-conflict behavior are unknown.
  11. The .codeiumignore and enterprise global-ignore contents and enforcement are unknown.
  12. Whether Restricted Mode is enabled and what security controls it supplies are unknown.
  13. The exact Cascade data path, processor, plan, training opt-out, retention, region and encryption enforcement are unknown.
  14. No independently attributable evaluation with exact client, service, model, mode, configuration, disclosure and public-artifact applicability was identified.
